items.reason: The && permission check allows only owners and wrongly rejects team admins.
It identifies the same blacklist bypass caused by comparing raw guest emails against a lowercased blacklist, with additional detail about attendee deduplication.
It requests using the booking organizer and their credentials for EventManager, correcting the same use of the requesting user's credentials.
Passing raw guests misclassifies existing attendees as new and sends them scheduled emails instead of add-guests updates.
The unbounded server-side guests array permits unlimited inserts and invitation emails; the comment requests the same missing size limit.
The server does not deduplicate repeated emails within a single request, allowing createMany to insert duplicate attendees.
